title: Existing daily news briefing with bounded deterministic retrieval

dependency_checks: Resolve private source, output, account and executor bindings; unresolved required bindings block dependent work.
Verify current authorization, tested capabilities and one shared writer lease, including independent external sessions.
Read exact source revisions and completeness; unavailable or partial sources never establish no work.
Preserve prior complete state and reconcile uncertain output with its original request ID before any repeat write.
Resolve actual capable worker bridge; exhausted Desktop Commander is unavailable, not repaired by a symbolic executor ref.
Use existing news_check.py; actual UTC request ID, fresh Eastern business date, fixed approved sources and encrypted state are required.
Feed metadata completeness is not major-news, civic-action or book-trend completeness; preserve original judgment checks and named fallback coverage.
Birthday evidence reuse retains News 21/7-day thresholds, distinct from Birthday 30-day policy; unresolved cart conflict grants no cart action.
Only acknowledge exact final output after readback; local packet acknowledgement never proves cloud/user delivery.

success_checks: Brief retains actual source links, relevant coverage gaps and original scope; headlines are not silently suppressed before confirmed delivery.
Task destination has matching actual final text; private packet acknowledgement references that exact output and request.
Timezone, first scheduled run and source completeness remain separate acceptance facts.
Record exact request, source revisions, output hash and native destination readback; label remaining coverage gaps.
